title: British Athletics Club entry – TCS London Marathon
claims: Club guaranteed entries are allocated by first-claim affiliated membership: clubs with 0–9 members receive zero; 10–39 members enter a ballot for 228 guaranteed entries (one per successful club); 40–189 members receive one guaranteed entry; 190+ members receive two.
Eligible clubs must be associated with British Athletics through England Athletics, Scottish Athletics, Welsh Athletics or Athletics Northern Ireland, with a minimum of 10 first-claim members.
Club entries are charged at the standard UK entry price of £69.99; allocation is automatic and clubs do not need to apply for their guaranteed places.
